name: bookarr
description: Radarr/Sonarr-style audiobook automation with Prowlarr and Overseerr-style requests

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @bookarr/api & npm run dev -w @bookarr/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bookarr/api && npm run build -w @bookarr/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bookarr/api && npm run typecheck -w @bookarr/web
